pebblekit

A set of tiny command-line tools for tiny scripts.

Install

npm install --global pebblekit

Features

  • Zero dependencies
  • Works offline
  • Every tool is under 200 lines

Options

FlagMeaning
--quietPrint nothing on success
--jsonMachine-readable output
--root <dir>Run relative to a directory
